newsitem.title: USA: U.S. "awash" in credit, Fed's Lindsey says.
newsitem.headline: U.S. "awash" in credit, Fed's Lindsey says.

text.p: The United States is awash in credit that is available at historically low interest rates, Federal Reserve Governor Lawrence Lindsey said on Thursday.
"Credit is more than ample at spreads and rates which are low by historic standards," Lindsey told the Investment Program Association. "We are awash in credit."
Lindsey stressed the importance of a stable, low-inflation monetary policy, arguing that that would help augment economic growth by improving the way that resources are used.
"A stable and a predictable economic environmment is most likely to foster sound business decisions," he said.
